text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYOIL SALES - U.S. vegetable oil dealers said China this week bought between 20,000 and 30,000 tonnes of South American soybean oil for January and February shipment. One dealer said China on Wednesday bought 10,000 tonnes of Argentina soybean oil at $513.00 per tonne, FOB, and on Tuesday bought 10,000 of Brazilian soybean oil at $507.00. Other soybean oil dealers said the Argentina sale may have been 20,000 tonnes, but they could not confirm that amount.

SOYOIL SALES - The Commodity Credit Corp (CCC) of USDA said it bought 10,370 tonnes of crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The deal included 3,500 tonnes at $514.77 per tonne, 3,500 at $518.63, 2,370 at $520.29 and 1,000 at $518.07. All values are FOB and shipment is for Feb 3-18. Cargill Inc sold the 1,000-tonne lot and Bunge Corp the rest.

WHEAT SALES - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd on Thursday jointly bought 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Mitsubishi Corp, traders said. Shipment was set for February 20-March 20 to South Korea's port of Pusan.

WHEAT SALES - Slovenia late Wednesday bought between 40,000 and 50,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat for arrival by February 28, several U.S. exporters said. Price information was vague. One U.S. exporter said the wheat was bought at around $181 a tonne, cost and freight, but another said $186 and $191 C and F.

RICE SALE - Japan's Food Agency said it bought 64,350 tonnes of rice Thursday, fulfilling its obligations for this fiscal year under a global trade pact. It said it bought 31,000 tonnes from the United States, 10,000 from China, 10,000 from Australia and 13,350 from Thailand.

WHEAT TENDERS - Yemen has postponed a tender for soft wheat grain and soft wheat flour initially scheduled for January 7 until January 14, grain traders said. Yemen is seeking 200,000 tonnes of European or U.S soft wheat flour for shipment by June. Within the EU Yemen is seeking French, Dutch, German or Belgian flour. It also seeks 200,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for shipment between June and August.
- Lebanon's economy ministry plans to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later this month, the Cereals and Sugar Beet Office said. "It will be Hard Red Winter No.2," the official said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Armenia is seeking about 65,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL 480 program for January 23-February 6 delivery, its U.S. export agent said. Offers are to be submitted on January 15 and will be valid until January 16.
- Taiwan will tender this Thursday for about 85,000 to 86,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for January-February delivery, several U.S. exporters said.

WHEAT TENDERS - Philippine firms plan to buy 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for February requirements, , traders said on Thursday. The wheat includes 29,000 tonnes dark northern spring wheat, 14 pct protein and 6,000 of western white wheat.
- Pakistan will be tender Jan 12 for 315,000 tonnes of Australian white milling wheat and U.S. soft white wheat. Shipment was slated for February 1-28.

- Bangladesh seeks 100,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 wheat or Australian standard or better Canadian winter red/spring wheat for shipment by February 21. Offers are to be opened January 18 and the results announced two to three days later.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Friday for one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. No.2 corn, for March and April shipment local traders said.

BARLEY TENDER - The Cyprus Grain commission on Wedneasday invited tenders for the supply of 25,000 tonnes feed barley with a shipment period between Jan 15 and 30. The tender closing date is January 10.
SOYMEAL TENDER - South Korea's Korea Feed Association will invite tenders for 125,000 tonnes of soymeal on Monday. The tenders were divided into four positions for March 20.

- The Commodity Credit Corp said it seeks offers from exporters for 2,650 tonnes of 48 percent protein soybean meal for donation to Guatemala. Shipment is slated for between January 30 and February 25, 1997. Offers are due on January 14 at 1400 CST.
RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs is seeking to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for March shipment. Results would be Feb 13.
